message.content:
This is a CBP ruling on a matelassé bed covering of double woven cotton fabric with polyester stuffer yarns. It has no quilting, so the question is whether it belongs in 9404.90 (quilts, bedspreads, comforters) or 6304.11/6304.19 (other furnishing articles, bedspreads).

Heading 6304 covers bedspreads, and 6304.19 covers "other" bedspreads, with 6304.19.15 for cotton, not knitted or crocheted. Heading 9404 covers articles of bedding fitted with springs or stuffed with any material, and that would apply if the item were considered stuffed or padded. Here the stuffer yarns are integral to the weaving, so the item is a woven fabric (a matelassé bedspread) rather than a stuffed article. The matelassé bed coverings in similar rulings were classified in 6304.19.15 (bedspreads, of cotton, not knitted or crocheted).

The current tariff structure is 6304.19.15 00 for cotton bedspreads, and I believe the 10-digit code is 6304.19.1500 (the "Other" subheading 6304.19.15 under "Bedspreads: Other"). The 6304.19 subheadings are:
- 6304.19.10: of cotton, "Other" within 6304.19.1000 (Bedspreads, not knitted or crocheted: of cotton, 6304.19.15)
- 6304.19.20: of other materials (6304.19.2000)
- 6304.19.30: other (6304.19.30)

I'm going with 6304.19.1500.

{"hts_code": "6304.19.1500", "reason": "A woven cotton matelassé bed covering with integral polyester stuffer yarns and no quilting is a non-knitted cotton bedspread of heading 6304, not a stuffed or quilted article of heading 9404."}
